text:
Alex: Quick heads-up — planning to deploy routing/v4 at 13:00 PT today. Observability changes bundled with this rollout:
- new dashboard panels for per-model token latency and token-type breakdown
- trace sampling bumped to 5% for the routing path during canary
- temporary p99 token latency alert relaxed from 800ms -> 1200ms while we validate
Anyone available to own the deploy and smoke checks?

Maria: I can run the deploy. Will start at 13:00 PT and follow the smoke checklist. @deploy-bot can you open the window and create the canary? :+1:

deploy-bot: Deploy window created: 2026-03-17 20:00 UTC (13:00 PT). Canary policy = 10% for 15m -> 50% for 15m -> 100% if stable. Rollback hook enabled.

Jamal: I've pushed the dashboard changes to /dashboards/model_perf/routing_v4 (dash link: https://grafana.internal/d/routing_v4). Added recentness filter + token-breakdown heatmap. Also created a short query you can use for baseline: `sum(rate(model_token_latency_sum[5m])) / sum(rate(model_token_latency_count[5m]))`

Sara: Paste the exact alert change so I can update the oncall playbook and slack alert text. Who's primary oncall for the window?

Alex: Alert diff (will flip during canary and revert after 1h stable):
```yaml
alert: RoutingV4P99TokenLatencyHigh
expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(model_token_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, model)) > 1.2
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "routing/v4 p99 token latency > 1.2s"
```
Rollback condition note: if p99 stays >1.2s for 10m or error-rate > 0.5% for 5m, cut canary back to previous model.

Maria: Smoke checklist I'll run when I flip canary:
- curl /health on canary endpoint (expect 200)
- run warmup script to populate KV cache: `./tools/warmup --model routing/v4 --keys 1000`
- run latency baseline script: `./bench/latency_test --qps 50 --duration 2m --model routing/v4`
- verify trace spans show routing_v4 handler and sample rate is 5%

Jamal: If you see trace/error spike, immediately set tracing back to 1% and cut canary. I added a small grafana panel to show trace rate by service so it's easier to watch.

Sara: I'll own oncall for the window. My quick rollback triggers: p50 > 400ms for 10m OR total errors > 0.5% for 5m. If either fires, page and then we do immediate rollback to routing/v3. I'll also post a go/no-go after the 10m canary.

Alex: After we hit 100% and stable for 1h, revert the relaxed alert back to 800ms and reduce trace sample to 1%. Maria — please post deploy notes and link to perf snapshots.

Maria: Starting canary now (13:00 PT). Running warmup...

Maria: Warmup OK, /health 200, baseline latency median ~ 120ms. Canary 10% in flight.

Maria: 15m canary check: p99 = 930ms, errors 0.12% — all within expected. Stepping to 50%.

Jamal: Looks clean on traces and token breakdown. No unusual span increases.

Maria: 50% stable after 15m, promoting to 100%.

Sara: Watching — all green so far. No alerts. I'll keep monitoring for the next hour and will post if anything changes. :eyes:

Alex: Thanks everyone. Maria — once you're done, paste the deployment permalink and the perf snapshots so we can attach to the release notes.

Maria: Done: https://deploys.internal/1836501234 and perf snapshots saved at https://perf-snapshots.internal/routing_v4/1836501234. Reverting alert and sampling scheduled in 1h unless issues.

Sara: Noted. I'll close the loop after the 1h mark. Great job y'all. :tada:
